fullSuite: 33/33 passed after all implementation and repairs
provenance: Real GPU readbacks. Individual panels show staged implementation, with earlier features retained. Developer flags isolate old sampler, RR, light-group and emission-power behavior; later sampler specialization/picking trim is covered by final suite. Reference uses independent seed 137, finite spp and the same bounce limit. No generated imagery and no denoising in quality comparisons.

tasks.R-A03: Separate production benchmark and instrumented profile. Per-sample node/triangle/scatter/material-texel/light-attempt/invalid-light counts; beauty and second moment bit-identical.
tasks.R-Q05: Fixed camera/lens-reserved/12-per-bounce domains; digitally shifted 120-dimension Sobol, counter-hash deeper and variable alpha/boundary streams; seed persists through scene/job snapshots. Compile variants remove unused legacy paths.
tasks.R-Q06: RR decision compensates radiance eta^2 only for transmitted events. RR start depth configurable in preview/formal UI, JSON and jobs; raw throughput is unchanged.
tasks.R-Q07: HDR solid-angle luminance integral versus global finite solid-angle radiance proxy. Probability rounded to 1/16 with support floor; shared selection/query/MIS probability.
tasks.R-Q08: 16x16 uniform-area UV quadrature of emission and Mask/Blend alpha; color decoded before interpolation; UV transform/wrap/point-filter conventions; world area and shared mesh/material cache. Small support floor prevents missed islands from losing all NEE mass.

limits: Instrumentation has overhead; its timings are not production performance.
No hardware register/spill/bandwidth/occupancy measurement; resource byte counts are estimates.
Digital shift is not full nested Owen scrambling; first 120 dimensions use existing Sobol matrices, deeper dimensions use independent counter hashing.
Lens dimensions are reserved; no new physical lens implementation.
Global group heuristic is not a spatial Light Tree. UV quadrature is approximate power estimation, not emitter-internal texture importance sampling.
Finite-depth and finite-spp reference errors remain; fixture reductions do not guarantee equal gains on every scene.
Adjacent IOR/initial nested media and full shading-normal energy compensation remain outside this batch.
background: Windows private desktop UI audit inputDesktopWindows=0. Real viewport and RR dialog screenshots visually checked; no input to user desktop.
documentationValidation: Content/code reconciliation, local link existence and git diff --check; no additional GPU run after documentation-only changes.
